steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((name) => name.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; if (globalThis.__p08m?.handler) ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, globalThis.__p08m.handler); const NL = String.fromCharCode(10); const state = { sent: [] }; state.handler = (data, dryRun) => { if (dryRun) return; state.sent.push({ board: { ...(globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().blackboard ?? {}) }, text: typeof data?.prompt === 'string' ? data.prompt : (data?.messages ?? []).map((message) => String(message?.content ?? '')).join(NL) }); }; ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, state.handler); globalThis.__p08m = state; return { macroEngine: ctx.powerUserSettings?.experimental_macro_engine ?? null };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const board = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().blackboard ?? {}; const expected = (key) => board[key] === undefined || board[key] === null ? '(unset)' : String(board[key]); const got = Object.fromEntries(['go', 'location', 'coins'].map((key) => [key, ctx.substituteParams(`{{story_quality_${key}}}`)])); const fail = Object.entries(got).filter(([key, value]) => value !== expected(key)).map(([key, value]) => `${key}: macro ${value}, blackboard ${expected(key)}`); if (fail.length) throw new Error(fail.join('; ')); return got;

'(unset)' : String(value); const want = `[Story state: location=${show(sent.board.location)} coins=${show(sent.board.coins)}]`; const at = Math.max(0, sent.text.indexOf('[Story state')); if (sent.text.includes('{{story_quality_')) throw new Error('the request carries an unresolved {{story_quality_*}} macro'); if (!sent.text.includes(want)) throw new Error(`the request ST posted does not carry ${want}: ${sent.text.slice(at, at + 80)}`); return want;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const board = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().blackboard ?? {}; if (board.location !== 'yard') throw new Error(`/cp set location yard did not land by the boundary: ${board.location}`); const value = ctx.substituteParams('{{story_quality_location}}'); if (value !== 'yard') throw new Error(`macro reads ${value} after the boundary applied yard`); return value;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const kept = ctx.substituteParams('{{story_quality_go}}'); const gone = ctx.substituteParams('{{story_quality_coins}}'); const fail = []; if (gone !== '{{story_quality_coins}}') fail.push(`coins is not a quality of the new story, yet the macro resolved to ${gone}`); if (kept === '{{story_quality_go}}') fail.push('go is a quality of the new story, yet its macro did not register'); const state = globalThis.__p08m; ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, state.handler); delete globalThis.__p08m; if (fail.length) throw new Error(fail.join('; ')); return { kept, gone };
